summary.key_theme: Microsoft 憑藉強勁的雲端運算與 AI 需求，在 2027 財年第一季財報中繳出亮眼成績，成功抵銷市場對資本支出過高的擔憂。

bullish.title: MSFT Stock Gains 3% After-Hours As AI Demand Powers Q1 Cloud Revenue, Q2 Guidance Beat With Positive Cash Flows
bullish.reason: Microsoft 財報表現優異，營收達 923 億美元，年增 19%，且 Azure 雲端業務成長強勁，顯示 AI 需求已轉化為實質營收。

bullish.title: Microsoft (MSFT) Q1 2027 Earnings Call Transcript — Cloud revenue surged 30% as AI adoption accelerated across enterprise customers.
bullish.reason: 雲端營收激增 30%，證實企業端對 AI 解決方案的採用率正在加速，為長期成長奠定基礎。

bullish.title: Microsoft's Satya Nadella says 24 new data centers built during Q1
bullish.reason: 單季新建 24 座資料中心，展現公司在 AI 基礎設施上的強大執行力與擴張決心。

bearish.title: Why Is Microsoft (MSFT) Offering Buyouts To 60,000 Employees?
bearish.reason: 針對 6 萬名員工提出自願離職計畫，引發市場對於組織結構調整或潛在營運成本壓力的擔憂。

bearish.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq Futures Dip As Weaker-Than-Expected Alphabet Earnings Reignite AI Spending Worries
bearish.reason: 雖然 Microsoft 財報亮眼，但同業 Alphabet 財報疲軟引發市場對整體科技業 AI 資本支出過高的系統性擔憂。

neutral.title: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq Futures Mixed After Fed Holds Rates Steady
neutral.reason: 聯準會維持利率不變，符合市場預期，對 Microsoft 股價影響中性。

neutral.title: Here's what options traders see before Alphabet, Microsoft report after the bell
neutral.reason: 財報公布前的選擇權市場波動預測，屬於事件前的市場情緒觀察，不影響公司基本面。
